name: change-cycle
description: One code change from radar to every site: mine a file's co-change partners before an edit, map which consumers an interface change breaks, and apply a decided change uniformly across many sites

interface.shortDescription: Find what a code change touches before you make it, then apply it everywhere it must land
interface.longDescription: Three skills for one chain. co-change-radar runs before a non-trivial edit and mines the file's own commit history for the partners that habitually change with it, forcing a disposition for each one the diff does not touch. contract-change-propagation runs when the edit changes a shared interface, classifying each delta and enumerating the consumers before it lands. migration-campaign applies a decided mechanical change uniformly across many sites: shards, a pilot on the riskiest shard, a durable burndown, and verification per shard.
defaultPrompt: Before I edit this file, what usually changes with it?
Add another endpoint like the existing ones
Map what this signature change breaks
Apply this rename across every call site
